text.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ لَهُۥ صَاحِبُهُۥ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهُۥٓ أَكَفَرْتَ بِٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ مِن تُرَابٍۢ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ ثُمَّ سَوَّىٰكَ رَجُلًۭا

words.gloss_range: completed speech act that opens the companion's counter-reply
words.root_gloss_range: speech, saying, and held-position range; local use is explicit quoted speech with corrective force

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: dative addressee marker governed by the speech verb
the companion named as delayed subject of the speech verb

words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) opens the ayah as a completed speech event, not a tentative aside. The verb first launches the reply, then aims it through {{ar:لَهُ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) before naming {{ar:صَاحِبُهُ}} ({{tr:ṣāḥibuhu}}), so confrontation is built into the speech frame. Same-surah speech turns at 18:34 and 18:36 make this answer a reversal inside the dialogue, and the quoted span carries the accusation and the creation proof as one reply.

topics.headline: completed counter-speech frames the rebuke
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins as a firm speech-turn answering the prior boast and denial (18:34, 18:36), with the later creation argument held inside that one reply.
topics.reason: The rows converge on perfect-aspect speech, addressee-before-subject routing, same-surah dialogue echoes (18:34, 18:36), and the quoted-content span; local syntax supports those payoffs without needing a broader speech sense.

words.gloss_range: dative addressee marking with a bound third-person pronoun

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the responder named after the addressee is targeted
later debate verb sharing the same pronoun thread

words.prose: {{ar:لَهُ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) makes the rebuke face the prior speaker directly. Its bound pronoun carries the garden owner from 18:36 into the new speech frame, and its position before {{ar:صَاحِبُهُ}} ({{tr:ṣāḥibuhu}}) lets the target of correction be heard before the responder is named. The same pronoun thread returns in {{ar:يُحَاوِرُهُ}} ({{tr:yuḥāwiruhu}}), binding address and debate into one scene.

topics.headline: direct addressee carried through the scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rebuke is not general doctrine but a face-to-face answer aimed at the same person who just spoke.
topics.reason: The dative preposition and suffix are syntactically governed by the speech verb, and the contextual antecedent makes the addressee continuity locally licensed.

words.gloss_range: relational companion as delayed nominative speaker
words.root_gloss_range: companionship, association, and protective accompaniment; local sense is the addressee's companion speaking as corrective counterpart
words.prose: {{ar:صَاحِبُهُ}} ({{tr:ṣāḥibuhu}}) names the speaker only after the speech act and its target have been set. The active participle and suffix make him a continuing companion, not an outsider, so the rebuke comes from within the relationship that was already present at 18:34; the root-family guarding pressure survives as corrective companionship rather than as a separate local sense. The same companion-role now reverses direction: the one beside the boaster becomes the one who answers him.

topics.headline: relational companion becomes the answering speaker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the corrective voice comes from the addressee's own companion, turning proximity into authorized rebuke.
topics.reason: The local parse identifies the word as the subject of the speech verb, while the suffix, active participle form, and same-surah recurrence (18:34, 18:37) support the relational reversal payoff.

review_notes: The guarding pressure from the root family is retained only as relational corrective force, not as a separate local sense of protector.

words.gloss_range: circumstantial connector introducing the live debate frame

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the circumstantial clause introduced by the connector

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does more than add another event. Here it introduces the circumstantial clause {{ar:وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهُ}} ({{tr:wa-huwa yuḥāwiruhu}}), placing the rebuke inside an exchange already underway. The accusation is delayed long enough for the reader to hear it as a turn in live dialogue.

topics.headline: circumstantial link embeds the rebuke in debate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rebuke arrives while debate is already happening, not as a disconnected narrated statement.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence identifies the following clause as a strongly licensed circumstantial clause, supporting the CRITICAL rows that read the connector as wāw al-ḥāl.

words.gloss_range: explicit third-person subject in the circumstantial clause
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) gives the circumstantial clause its own visible subject after the main verb had allowed the subject to emerge later. That explicit pronoun stabilizes the scene: the same dialogue participant remains active while the speech is delivered. The reference is most naturally the companion, while the reciprocal frame still keeps both men in view.

topics.headline: explicit subject stabilizes the ongoing debate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the circumstantial clause is a stable live scene with an explicit participant, not a vague adverbial aside.
topics.reason: The explicit pronoun is locally supported as the subject of the ḥāl clause; referent ambiguity is narrowed by the subject relation to the companion while preserving the two-party dialogue pressure.

review_notes: Referent ambiguity is acknowledged but not allowed to override the stronger local reading that the companion is the speaker-debater.

words.gloss_range: ongoing reciprocal debating directed toward the addressee
words.root_gloss_range: returning, exchange, and dialogue range; local Form III selects reciprocal conversation with return-answer pressure
words.prose: {{ar:يُحَاوِرُهُ}} ({{tr:yuḥāwiruhu}}) closes the frame before the accusation with an imperfect Form III verb: the rebuke is delivered while exchange is still in motion. The root's return pressure makes dialogue feel like arguments moving back and forth, and the object suffix keeps that reciprocity directed toward the same addressee. The repetition from 18:34 gives the parable matched dialogue panels, with the boast and the rebuke housed in the same debate wording.

topics.headline: ongoing reciprocal debate becomes the gateway to accusation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the companion's rebuke is an answering turn inside active debate, with return-motion and reciprocity shaping how the accusation is heard.
topics.reason: The imperfect ḥāl-clause verb, Form III morphology, object suffix, and 18:34 recurrence support reciprocal ongoing debate; variant and wider root rows are narrowed to contrastive apparatus rather than controlling the local parse.

review_notes: The alternate reading with hostile disputation is kept as contrast; the local canonical form remains reciprocal dialogue.

words.gloss_range: reproachful second-person question charging completed denial and ingratitude
words.root_gloss_range: covering, denying, and ingratitude range; local use is theological denial with ethical and covering-image pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: prepositional object that attaches denial to the relative pronoun
dust source that sharpens the covering-image irony

words.prose: {{ar:أَكَفَرْتَ}} ({{tr:a-kafarta}}) is formally a question but functions as rebuke. The hamza attaches directly to a perfect second-person verb, so the charge sounds like an already committed denial. Because the verb is completed by {{ar:بِٱلَّذِي}} ({{tr:bi-lladhī}}), the denial is not abstract: it is denial of the One who created him. The root's covering image becomes locally sharp when the accusation is soon set beside {{ar:تُرَابٍ}} ({{tr:turābin}}), the earth-material of his origin.

topics.headline: reproachful denial question pivots into creation proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question is a direct accusation of completed denial, and that the root's covering image is made ironic by the dust-origin proof.
topics.reason: The interrogative hamza, perfect 2ms verb, bi-governed object, and following creation clause support the rebuke and denial payoffs; variant imprecation and expiation contrast are narrowed to non-governing apparatus.

review_notes: The covering image survives as local irony with dust, while the selected sense remains denial and ingratitude toward the Creator.

words.gloss_range: object-marking preposition after the denial verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the denial verb governed into a specified object
the relative pronoun governed by the preposition

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is the small hinge that prevents {{ar:أَكَفَرْتَ}} ({{tr:a-kafarta}}) from remaining generic. It governs {{ar:ٱلَّذِي}} ({{tr:alladhī}}), so the accusation is grammatically attached to the One defined by creating the addressee. The particle binds denial and creation evidence in one construction.

topics.headline: preposition binds denial to the Creator-definition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accusation has a precise object: denial is directed toward the Creator identified by the following relative clause.
topics.reason: The preposition is syntactically forced as the complement marker for the kufr verb and bridges directly into the relative clause.

words.gloss_range: definite relative pronoun identifying God through creation action

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the creation verb that begins the relative clause
the final shaping-result phrase gathered into the relative clause

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِي}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) identifies the denied referent by action rather than by direct naming. The relative pronoun gathers {{ar:خَلَقَكَ}} ({{tr:khalaqaka}}), the two source phrases, and {{ar:سَوَّىٰكَ رَجُلًا}} ({{tr:sawwāka rajulan}}) into one definition: the One who made the addressee's existence undeniable.

topics.headline: relative pronoun defines God by creating
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rebuke makes creation itself the identifier of the denied One.
topics.reason: The relative clause is syntactically forced, and the following verbs and source phrases are governed within that defining clause.

words.gloss_range: completed creation of the addressee, governing the first two source stages
words.root_gloss_range: creating, measuring, forming, and fabrication range; local use selects real measured origination by the Creator

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first source-material phrase governed by the creation verb
second source-material phrase governed elliptically by the creation verb
later completion verb contrasted with origination

words.prose: {{ar:خَلَقَكَ}} ({{tr:khalaqaka}}) turns accusation into evidence. The perfect active verb makes the addressee's origin an accomplished divine act, and the suffix makes the proof personal: you yourself are the created object. The verb governs both {{ar:مِنْ تُرَابٍ}} ({{tr:min turābin}}) and the elliptical {{ar:مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ}} ({{tr:min nuṭfatin}}), before a different verb, {{ar:سَوَّىٰكَ}} ({{tr:sawwāka}}), completes the sequence. Cross-surah dust-and-drop creation formulas such as 22:5, 35:11, and 40:67 stand behind the compressed argument.

topics.headline: personal creation verb compresses the origin proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the proof is not abstract creation doctrine but the addressee's own completed origin, compressed into a staged formula.
topics.reason: The local grammar supports the active perfect verb, object suffix, shared governance over two source phrases, and coordination with the later completion verb; fabrication and smoothing pressures are narrowed to contrast and measured-formation color.

review_notes: The false-fabrication branch is retained only as irony against the denier's claim; the local verb means actual divine creation.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: dust noun governed by the source preposition
creation verb to which the source phrase attaches

words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) makes the first origin phrase material, not locative. It attaches {{ar:تُرَابٍ}} ({{tr:turābin}}) to {{ar:خَلَقَكَ}} ({{tr:khalaqaka}}) as source-substance, then prepares the matching second {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) phrase. The repeated source particle builds the first half of the staged origin chain.

topics.headline: first source preposition starts the material chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that dust is presented as the addressee's source-material, not merely a place associated with him.
topics.reason: The preposition is syntactically forced with the following genitive noun as source complement of the creation verb.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive dust as first material origin
words.root_gloss_range: dust, earth-material, poverty, and bodily association range; local use selects humble generic dust as creation source

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: source preposition governing the dust noun
nearby denial verb whose covering image interacts with dust

words.prose: {{ar:تُرَابٍ}} ({{tr:turābin}}) is genitive after {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}), so it names source-material rather than location. Its indefinite form makes the origin generic and unspecialized: the proud garden owner is traced to ordinary dust. The word also intensifies the nearby {{ar:أَكَفَرْتَ}} ({{tr:a-kafarta}}) because denial's covering image is heard against the very earth from which he was created; its root-family reach toward body/chest vocabulary keeps the movement from earth-material toward embodied man visible, while the dust-to-drop-to-man triplet begins at the lowest material point.

topics.headline: generic dust origin humbles the boast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first source noun lowers the addressee from wealth and denial back to ordinary dust, where the covering image of kufr becomes ironic.
topics.reason: Genitive source grammar, indefiniteness, creation-formula echoes, and proximity to the kufr verb support the topic; bodily and poverty/wealth branches are narrowed to contextual resonance.

review_notes: The tarāʾib and wealth/poverty rows are preserved as contextual resonance, not as alternate senses for the local noun.

words.gloss_range: first delayed sequence marker moving from dust to drop

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first material source before the sequence marker
second material source after the sequence marker

words.prose: {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) marks the move from {{ar:تُرَابٍ}} ({{tr:turābin}}) to {{ar:نُطْفَةٍ}} ({{tr:nuṭfatin}}) as a distinct stage, not an immediate afterthought. Its independent form and later repetition make the creation proof a measured three-phase rhythm: source matter, fluid stage, then completed formation.

topics.headline: first delayed marker starts the three-phase rhythm
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sequence advances by marked stages rather than by a flat list of origins.
topics.reason: The particle is locally licensed as a sequential connector between creation stages, and the repeated occurrence supports the phase-marker payoff.

words.gloss_range: second source preposition governed elliptically by the creation verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: earlier creation verb governing the elided second source phrase
drop noun governed by the repeated source preposition

words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) repeats the source relation without repeating {{ar:خَلَقَكَ}} ({{tr:khalaqaka}}). The ellipsis keeps the first creation verb active across the gap while changing the material to {{ar:نُطْفَةٍ}} ({{tr:nuṭfatin}}). The parallel {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) phrases make dust and drop comparable source stages before the syntax turns to direct shaping.

topics.headline: second source phrase repeats the creation relation elliptically
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the middle stage is grammatically tied to the first creation verb even though the verb is not repeated.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence licenses the second source complement under the earlier creation verb, and the parallel prepositional shape supports the staged-material payoff.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive drop as the middle creation source
words.root_gloss_range: small drop, trickling fluid, and slight remnant range; local use selects minimal fluid source in creation sequence

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: next sequence-and-shaping phrase after the middle source noun

words.prose: {{ar:نُطْفَةٍ}} ({{tr:nuṭfatin}}) is the second governed source, not the final object of creation. Its indefinite singular form keeps the origin materially slight: one small, unspecialized drop, a minimal carrier of living potential before the formed man appears. The word sits at the middle of the dust-to-drop-to-man sequence, turning inert earth into living developmental potential before {{ar:ثُمَّ سَوَّىٰكَ}} ({{tr:thumma sawwāka}}) changes the syntax to active shaping.

topics.headline: minimal drop becomes the middle stage of creation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the rhetorical distance between a tiny fluid source and the final formed man, with the middle noun holding the transition point.
topics.reason: The genitive source grammar, singular indefiniteness, and creation-heavy distribution support the payoff; reproductive specificity is narrowed to small-fluid source pressure rather than made exhaustive.

review_notes: The coded-information claim is retained only as a modern-style payoff about concentrated potential, not as a lexical requirement of the Arabic noun.

words.gloss_range: second delayed sequence marker pivoting from source phrase to shaping verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: source preposition pattern that the second sequence marker leaves behind
shaping verb introduced by the final sequence marker
climactic result noun reached by the final phase

words.prose: {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) repeats the phase-marker rhythm, but this time it does not introduce another {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) phrase. It pivots into {{ar:سَوَّىٰكَ}} ({{tr:sawwāka}}), so the sequence shifts from material sources to active divine formation. The second marker therefore carries the creation proof toward its climactic result, {{ar:رَجُلًا}} ({{tr:rajulan}}).

topics.headline: second marker pivots from sources to shaping
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repeated sequence marker now changes the syntax and raises the movement from source material to completed formation.
topics.reason: The second particle is locally followed by a coordinated verb rather than another source phrase, supporting both sequence and syntactic-pivot payoffs.

words.gloss_range: Form II completed proportioning of the addressee into human form
words.root_gloss_range: evening, leveling, proportioning, completing, equality, and establishment range; local use selects intensive bodily proportioning and completion

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: earlier creation verb sharing the addressee suffix
result noun of the shaping verb

words.prose: {{ar:سَوَّىٰكَ}} ({{tr:sawwāka}}) changes the construction from repeated source phrases to direct shaping of the addressee. The Form II perfect makes proportional completion an accomplished divine act, and the suffix repeats the same person addressed in {{ar:خَلَقَكَ}} ({{tr:khalaqaka}}). Its root field of evenness and completion remains positive here: the addressee is not self-established, but directly balanced and formed into {{ar:رَجُلًا}} ({{tr:rajulan}}). Creation-completion echoes at 32:9, 82:7, and 91:7 reinforce the final-stage payoff, while the same root's leveling use at 18:96 remains a contrast within Surah 18.

topics.headline: direct Form II shaping completes the creation sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final divine act is not generic making but direct, intensive proportioning of the same addressee into the form he now occupies.
topics.reason: The Form II perfect, object suffix, shift away from min-phrases, and result complement support direct proportioning; equality, establishment, and structural leveling are narrowed to root-field contrast.

review_notes: The root's equality and establishment branches are not treated as local senses; they remain provenance for the narrowed bodily-proportioning payoff.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative man as result state or second object
words.root_gloss_range: man, foot, walking, and embodied agency range; local use selects formed adult manhood as the result of divine proportioning

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the shaping verb for which manhood is the result term

words.prose: {{ar:رَجُلًا}} ({{tr:rajulan}}) is the ayah's closing word and the result term of {{ar:سَوَّىٰكَ}} ({{tr:sawwāka}}). Its accusative case permits a state or second-object reading, but both readings make manhood the outcome of divine proportioning. The indefinite form makes the result ordinary and broadly human, not a title of superiority. Its root family also lets embodied walking agency remain visible: the boast about support and future return is answered by one created, footed man whose maturity is received rather than self-made.

topics.headline: created manhood closes the rebuke
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speech lands on the addressee's own created body: simply a man, formed from sources he did not control.
topics.reason: The accusative indefinite noun is locally licensed as ḥāl or second object after the shaping verb; root-family walking imagery and same-surah human-support echoes (18:34) are narrowed to embodied-result payoff.

review_notes: The foot and walking family is preserved as embodied-agency color, not as an etymological replacement for the local noun 'man'.

baseline_models.mechanism: The attached companion speaks inside an ongoing reciprocal exchange; this is a corrective turn addressed to a person who is still being accompanied, not a detached verdict.

activation_trace.role: Negotiation over a matter makes the saying one turn in a live exchange.
Accompaniment keeps the correction relationally attached to its addressee.
Reviewing and returning speech supplies the reciprocal corrective mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A man asks another an accusatory question.
changed_reading.after: An attached companion answers within a continuing exchange in order to turn the addressee back.

baseline_models.mechanism: Kufr as covering makes the question expose a finished self that conceals both its maker and the favor embodied in its own existence.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the physical image for denial as concealment.
Covering a blessing identifies the concealed object as received benefaction.
Creative bringing-into-being names the agency hidden behind the completed person.

changed_reading.before: The question names disbelief in the Creator.
changed_reading.after: The question accuses the man of using his finished self to cover the Creator and the received favor of being made.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: خلقك من تراب ثم من نطفة ثم سواك رجلا
baseline_models.mechanism: The two ثم markers order measured material transitions from earth, through a water-drop, to an upright and mature human form; the result depends at every stage on an acting creator.

activation_trace.role: Prior measuring and proportioning supplies governance across the stages.
Earth and dust establish the low, undifferentiated material point of departure.
A clear drop, including generative fluid, supplies the small liquid intermediate.
Straightening and completion supply the transition into coherent bodily form.
Attained youth and strength make mature status itself a conferred stage.
Manhood is the resulting status, not the source of the process.

changed_reading.before: The verse gives a compressed statement of human creation.
changed_reading.after: The verse reconstructs the addressee as a staged dependency chain, stripping the completed man of any claim to self-production.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding boast measures the two companions by accumulated wealth, superior force, and supporting numbers; the focus question replaces that comparative scale with the addressee's wholly received material and human formation.

activation_trace.role: Outnumbering and competitive abundance supply the boast's comparative scale.
Accumulated wealth supplies the possessed quantity treated as personal worth.
Strength after lowliness supplies the claimed elevation over the companion.
A supporting group supplies the social force included in the boast.
Being brought into existence replaces possession with received existence.
The small generative drop collapses the boaster's scale of magnitude.
Mature strength appears as an attained gift rather than self-owned superiority.

structural_cues: 18:34 uses the same companion-and-dialogue frame to state the comparative boast that 18:37 answers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies more wealth, greater might, a supporting group, and received creation; I infer that comparative possession is the covering exposed by the question. A live alternative is that the question targets creed without recalibrating social rank.

changed_reading.after: It specifically resets the boaster's metric: wealth and entourage are additions to a man whose matter, growth, and completion were all received.

context_deltas.mechanism: The owner projects a favorable future return on conjecture; the companion's dialogue turns that projection around by returning him evidentially through his actual prior stages of origin.

activation_trace.role: Conjecture supplies the uncertain basis of the owner's future projection.
Being returned supplies the future movement claimed by the owner.
Return and destination give the projected movement an imagined favorable endpoint.
Return and reversal make the dialogue turn the projection back on its speaker.
Returned speech is the conversational vehicle of the temporal reversal.
Dust supplies the actual backward endpoint against which the imagined future is tested.

structural_cues: 18:36 projects 'if I am returned' and a better destination; 18:37 immediately answers with a backward من...ثم من...ثم sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conjecture, return, destination, dialogic return, and an origin sequence; I supply the arrow that retrospective creation is the answer to prospective self-assurance. The live alternative is a narrower reply about resurrection alone.

changed_reading.before: The creation sequence proves divine power against disbelief.
changed_reading.after: The companion counters an imagined upward future return with a verifiable backward return to low origins; the dialogue itself reverses the boast.

context_deltas.mechanism: The owner is surrounded by, then enters, a garden whose branch image is vegetal concealment; that material enclosure sharpens focus-kufr from abstract denial into vision screened by prosperity.

activation_trace.role: Encirclement around a center gives the garden a containing boundary.
Concealment supplies the garden's capacity to function as a veil.
Entry places the owner inside, rather than merely beside, the concealing enclosure.
Covering converts the physical enclosure into an epistemic mechanism.
Blocking truth states what the prosperous enclosure now prevents the owner from seeing.

structural_cues: 18:32 encircles the two gardens; 18:35 has the owner enter his garden before denying its disappearance; 18:37 asks whether he has covered the Creator.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosure, vegetal concealment, entry, and covering; I infer that physical enclosure becomes cognitive cover. The live alternative is that garden imagery and theological kufr remain independent.

changed_reading.before: Kufr is a proposition denied by the garden owner.
changed_reading.after: The garden's covering enclosure becomes the material screen through which its owner no longer sees the Creator behind prosperity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus moves from earth through a generative drop to a formed man, while the context moves the flourishing estate from river and water toward sunk water and exposed, unstable earth; person and property occupy one reversible material economy.

activation_trace.role: Earth supplies the human sequence's material baseline.
Water from a drop through larger bodies, including generative fluid, links bodily origin to the estate's water.
A river cutting through earth supplies the estate's life-bearing water phase.
The face of bare earth supplies the stripped estate's terminal material state.
A smooth place where feet cannot hold makes the returned earth unable to support possession.
Water itself is the vulnerable substance whose availability sustains the garden.
Descent into depth removes the water on which the visible abundance depends.

structural_cues: 18:33 supplies a river, 18:40 predicts bare slippery earth, 18:41 sinks the water, and 18:37 places earth and a liquid drop in the owner's own formation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the two material sequences; I supply the analogical arrow that the estate's reversal reveals the owner's matching contingency. The live alternative is that the later earth-and-water sequence concerns property only.

changed_reading.before: The owner's low origins humble him.
changed_reading.after: The owner and garden share one contingency: a water-derived man confronts an estate whose water can sink and whose growth can return to bare earth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The owner boasts of a supporting group, yet after loss no faction can aid him; against that failed social capital, the companion's preserving accompaniment and hard conversational reply become the only relation actually functioning as help.

activation_trace.role: A supporting group supplies the social backing in which the owner boasts.
A faction returning to its head supplies the organized aid that proves absent.
Aid and vindication state the function his supposed group cannot perform.
Preservation through companionship lets corrective presence count as protective aid.
The helper image makes the companion's returned speech a form of assistance.
Conversational review is the concrete action through which that aid is offered.

structural_cues: The same man boasts of entourage in 18:34, receives a companion's warning in 18:37, and has no faction able to support him in 18:43.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies boasted supporters, failed rescue, preserving companionship, and helper-dialogue images; I infer that warning functions as aid. The live alternative is that the companion relation carries no preserving force beyond identifying the speaker.

changed_reading.before: The companion is merely the speaker who rebukes the owner.
changed_reading.after: The rebuking companion, not the boasted entourage, is the only social relation functioning as aid; hard speech is companionship's preserving act.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the farmer sense of كفر rather than treating it as the focus form's ordinary doctrinal sense. It remains valid because 18:37 joins كفر directly to earth and a generative drop while 18:32 supplies cultivation. Render it only as an exploratory agrarian analogy, not as lexical disambiguation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أكفرت بالذي خلقك من تراب ثم من نطفة

activation_trace.role: Covering seed supplies the cultivator action that is reversed onto the owner.
Soil supplies the medium in which seed is covered and the owner's own material origin.
Generative fluid makes the owner himself a small implanted beginning.
Planting and growing supply the estate's explicit cultivation domain.
Growing wealth shows the cultivated yield that the owner mistakes for self-grounded possession.

changed_reading.before: A garden owner denies the one who created him.
changed_reading.after: The cultivator who covers seed in soil has covered the fact that he too is planted material; he mistakes himself for cultivator rather than cultivated.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the peerhood branch of ت ر ب is distant from the immediate dust sense. It remains anchored in the focus's companion and man language and is activated by the context's two men, more, and less. Render it as a secondary social-leveling resonance, never as a replacement translation for تراب.

activation_trace.role: Equality in age and companionship supplies latent peerhood inside the origin term.
Accompaniment anchors peerhood in the actual relation between the speakers.
Shared human manhood supplies the common rank beneath unequal assets.
Likeness and counterpart structure the narrative as a comparison of two men.
The paired men establish equal human category before property differentiates them.
Competitive abundance supplies the rank claim that peerhood resists.
Littleness supplies the acknowledged asset asymmetry without changing created rank.

changed_reading.before: The owner is humbled by a materially low origin.
changed_reading.after: The latent peerhood of dust restores the unequally wealthy companions to a common created human rank.

strongest_changes: The creation sequence answers the immediately preceding wealth-and-entourage boast by replacing comparative possession with received formation.
The owner's imagined favorable return is turned backward through his verifiable origin, making dialogue itself a reversal mechanism.
The enclosed garden sharpens kufr into prosperity functioning as a material and cognitive cover.
The owner and estate become parallel water-and-earth formations whose apparent completion can reverse.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's compact dust-drop-formation chain became a pivot that reorganized the surrounding garden narrative: wealth changed from proof of rank into a veil over received existence, projected return was reversed into recalled origin, and corrective companionship emerged as the only social aid actually present.
remaining_uncertainties: The garden-as-veil mechanism depends on carrying the concealment branch of ج ن ن into the owner's perception rather than leaving it as ordinary garden naming.
The estate's water-to-earth reversal is an analogical parallel to bodily origin, not an explicit claim that the focus states bodily return.
The cultivator and peerhood outliers are branch-driven resonances and should not control lexical translation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Dialogue restores a forgotten production sequence.** `ق و ل` B001 (“uttered speech”) answers comparative boasting with staged origins: dust, drop, then formed man. The later barrier is likewise assembled through ordered materials and actions (18:95–96), then explicitly denied permanence (18:98). I infer that recounting sequence breaks the illusion of self-grounded completion. The companion’s speech functions as causal re-education.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The staged barrier-making at 18:96 echoed the companion’s staged creation argument at a material scale.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Human and garden share a water-dependent material chain.** `ن ط ف/B002` includes clear water from a drop to a sea and semen from which offspring comes; `ن ط ف/B003` adds dripping, flowing wetness. The focus window begins with two gardens yielding beside a river (18:32–33) and ends with their water threatened with sinking (18:41–42). I infer that the origin sequence places the boasting man inside the same contingent water economy as his estate. `نُطْفَة` therefore reads as an ecological equalizer as well as a stage of human generation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:40–42 removed surface, water, and structure in sequence, confirming that the human `نُطْفَة` and garden belong to one contingent water economy.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin başka bir şeyle yakın ve süreğen biçimde birlikte bulunmasını çekirdek anlam olarak verir. Kişi, hayvan, yer ve zamanla kurulan eşlik ilişkisi bu çekirdeğe girerken sahiplik, bir işin başında bulunma ve yanında bir eşlikçi bulunması belirli yapılara bağlı uzantılardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eşlik çekirdeği ile sahiplik, görev ve bir eşlikçisi bulunma gibi yapıya bağlı kullanımları ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi ya da şeyle geçici olmayan biçimde birlikte bulunmak, ona eşlik etmek veya onunla yakınlığını sürdürmektir. Belirli yapılarda bir şeyin sahibi ya da sorumlusu olmayı ve kişinin yanında bir eşlikçi bulunmasını da anlatır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, iki tarafın yakın ve süreğen biçimde birlikte bulunması ya da birinin ötekine eşlik etmesidir.
Eşlik eden taraf kişi, hayvan, yer veya zamanla ilişkili olabilir; tekil eşlikçi ve eşlikçiler topluluğu da adlandırılabilir.
Belirli ad tamlamalarında bir şeyin sahibi, ona bağlı kişi veya onun işini yürüten sorumlu kastedilir.
Bir kişinin yanında kendisine eşlik eden birinin bulunması da bu anlam alanının yapıya bağlı uzantısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, sıradan bir araya gelmeden daha güçlü olan yakın ve sürekli eşliktir; kişi adları, topluluk adları, sahiplik ve sorumluluk kullanımları bu çekirdeğin çevresinde yer alır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi nimeti yadsımayı, onu örtmeyi ve gereği olan şükrü yerine getirmemeyi aynı çekirdekte birleştirir; dalın geçici çerçevesi bu koşulu doğru yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Nimeti yadsıma çekirdeği yalın ve türemiş kullanımlarda korunur; nimetle kurulan yapı ve aşırılık bildiren kişi nitelemesi ayrı gerçekleşmelerdir.

concept_map.definition: Bir nimeti tanımamak, değerini örtmek veya onun gerektirdiği şükrü yerine getirmemektir. Bu tutumda aşırı olan kişi de aynı anlam alanında nitelenir.

facets.statement: Bir nimeti yadsıma veya şükrünü yerine getirmeyerek değerini örtme.
Nimetleri sürekli ve aşırı biçimde yadsıyan kişi bu tutumun yoğunlaşmış taşıyıcısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar nimeti yadsımayı şükrün karşıtı sayar; örtme açıklaması, nimetin gerektirdiği şükrü yerine getirmemeyi bu karşıtlığın belirleyici davranışı yapar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Nimeti tanımama ile ona şükretmeme çekirdeğini kısa ve doğal biçimde verir.

error_profile.preserves: Nimetin inkâr edilmesini ve şükrün terk edilmesini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nimetin veya yapılan iyiliğin tanınmadığı gündelik bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yapılan iyiliği tanımama ve karşılığında şükretmeme tutumunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: nimeti yadsımak ve şükrünü yerine getirmemek
iyilikleri karşılıksız ve teşekkürsüz kalan cömert adam

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Nimeti tanımama ve ona şükretmeme iki dalda da merkezîdir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal nankörlüğü daha geniş bir davranış kümesine yayar; bu dal doğrudan nimet ile şükür arasındaki ilişkiyle sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal nimeti tanımamayı ve şükrünü terk etmeyi bildirir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Biri nimetin değerini örter ve şükrü bırakır; diğeri nimeti tanır ve şükrü gösterir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; daha geniş nankörlük dalı yakın eş, şükür dalı ise doğrudan karşıt kutup olarak yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه كفر النعمة وكفرانها وجحودها وترك شكرها والكفور في كفران النعمة

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişiyi yalnızca meslek adıyla değil, tohumu toprakla örtme gerekçesiyle birlikte anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal çiftçiyi özellikle tohumu toprakla örtmesi bakımından adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Gönderim örtüşse de adlandırma sınırı farklıdır: biri tohumu örtme, diğeri toprağı işleme ve meslek yönünü öne çıkarır.

root_profile.summary: Kökün dalları fiziksel örtme çekirdeğinden gece ve suyun örtücülüğüne, tohum ile bitki kılıflarına, dinî gerçeği veya nimeti reddetmeye ve günah yükünü gidermeye uzanan radyal bir yapı gösterir; ayrıca uzak yer, dağ geçidi, boyun eğme, taçlandırma ve aynı biçimli bitki-madde adları gibi sözlüksel olarak ayrışmış dallar bulunur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, nesnenin kesilmesi ya da işlenmesi öncesinde ölçülmesini ve sınırlarının uygun biçimde belirlenmesini ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Deri örneği bu işlemi somutlaştırır; yoktan var etme ve yalan uydurma anlamları bu dalın parçası değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın ölçme ve biçme anlamını karşılar; başka dallardaki kalıplaşmış kullanımlar buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir nesneyi kesme ya da uygulama öncesinde ölçüp sınırlarını uygun ve düzgün biçimde belirlemektir.

facets.statement: Nesnenin ölçüsü ve sınırları yapılacak işten önce belirlenir.
Bir deri parçasını kesmeden önce tuluma göre ölçmek bu işlemin örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, anlamı ölçme, oranlama ve kesmeden önce sınır koyma çevresinde birleştirir; düzgün ve uygun ölçü vurgusu da bu çekirdeği tamamlar.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deri, kumaş veya benzeri bir nesnenin kesime hazırlanmasını anlatan bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Nesneyi ölçme ve uygulama sınırlarını belirleme işlemlerini kaybeder.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه التقدير والقياس قبل القطع أو الفعل، ومنه خلق الأديم وخلق الأمر بمعنى قدره.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi daha önce örneği olmadan ortaya koymak ya da başka bir şeyden yeni bir varlık meydana getirmektir. Eylem, onu yapanı ve sonuçta ortaya çıkan varlıkları adlandıran kullanımlara da uzanır.

Ortaya çıkarma, öncesiz bir örnek olmadan veya mevcut bir şeyden gerçekleştirilebilir.
Eylemi yapan üretici ile ortaya çıkan varlıklar eylem adından türeyen biçimlerle adlandırılır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه خلق الله الخلق، والخالق الصانع، وإبداع الشيء أو إيجاده من شيء.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الخالق الصانع (ayn)؛ الخلق مصدر خلق الله الخلق يخلقهم خلقا (jamhara)؛ هم خليقة الله (sihah)؛ الخالق والخلاق؛ الخلق ابتداع الشيء على مثال لم يسبق إليه (tahdhib)؛ يستعمل في إبداع الشيء من غير أصل ولا احتذاء؛ ويستعمل في إيجاد الشيء من الشيء (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تمام الخلق، اعتدال الصورة، ظهور التصوير، والهيئات والأشكال المدركة بالبصر.
يدخل فيه الخلق والخليقة والطبيعة والسليقة والفطرة والمروءة والدين من جهة الصفة الباطنة والمعاشرة بها.
يدخل فيه خليق بكذا، أخلق به، مخلقة للخير، وما يكون الشخص كأنه مهيأ أو مقدر لذلك.
يدخل فيه الخلاق بمعنى النصيب والحظ، ولا سيما النصيب من الخير أو الآخرة أو الدين.
يدخل فيه خلق الكذب واختلاقه وتخلقه، الكلام المزور أو المفتعل، والخرافات المنسوبة أو المنحولة.
يدخل فيه الأملس المصمت، الصخرة الخلقاء، استواء السحاب أو الرسم، السهم أو القدح أو الحبل المملس، ومواضع الجبهة والوجه والظهر والغار المسماة خلقاء أو خليقاء.
يدخل فيه خلق الثوب وأخلق، الثوب الخلق والأخلاق، التمزق والبلى وذهاب الزئبر أو أثر الاستعمال.
يدخل فيه الخلوق المعروف من الطيب، التخليق والتخلق به، وطلاء غيره بالخلوق.
يدخل فيه الخليقة بمعنى النقرة في الصفا أو الصخرة يجتمع فيها ماء السماء، والدحلان والآبار الحديثة الحفر.
يدخل فيه وصف المرأة الرتقاء أو الخلقاء من جهة الانسداد والإصمات المشبه بالصفاة الخلقاء.

root_profile.summary: Kök, ölçüp sınır koyma ve var etmeden dış biçim, iç huy, yaraşırlık, pay ve söz uydurmaya; ayrıca düz yüzey, kumaş yıpranması, sürülen koku, su tutan oyuk ve bedensel kapanmaya uzanan çok dallı bir anlam yapısı taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı bir şeyin eğrilikten kurtulup kendi yapısı içinde düzgünleşmesini, eksiksiz ve sağlıklı duruma gelmesini açıkça aynı dalda toplar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın düzgünleşme anlamını korur; arazi, çocuklar ve hayvanlarla kurulan özel sözlerin kapsamını ayrıca belirtir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi eğrilik, eksiklik ya da yapısal bozukluktan arındırarak kendi içinde düzgün ve tam duruma getirme; varlığın bu düzgün, sağlıklı ya da iyi durumda bulunması.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin kendi yapısı içinde eğrilikten kurtulması ve düzgün duruma gelmesi çekirdektir.
İnsan yaratılışında düzgünlük, görünür bozukluk ve hastalık bulunmayan tam bir yapıyı anlatır.
Çocukların ve hayvanların iyi durumda olması, belirli bir söz kalıbına bağlı değerlendirmedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar düzgünleştirme ile düzgün duruma gelmeyi birbirine bağlı verir; insan yapısındaki sağlık ve tamlık ile ev halkı ve hayvanların iyi durumu bu çekirdeğin özel görünümleridir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه السواء وسط الشيء أو الدار، وسواء السبيل، وكلمة سواء، وعلى سواء، ومكان سوى بمعنى وسط أو عدل أو منصف أو مستو معلوم.
يدخل فيه سوى وسواء بمعنى غير، والبدل أو المكان المنفصل عن المخاطب في نحو عندي رجل سواك.
يدخل فيه قصدت سوى فلان بمعنى قصدت قصده، وصرف الكلام أو المدح نحو شخص.
يدخل فيه السِيّ بمعنى الفضاء الواسع من الأرض أو الموضع الأملس، وما وصف من كلأ أو ماء بالسعة والكثرة.
يدخل فيه السَّويّة وهي كساء أو قتب أو برذعة تجعل على ظهر البعير أو حول سنامه للركوب.
يدخل فيه أسوى الشيء أو الحرف إذا أسقطه أو تركه وأغفله.
يدخل فيه ليلة السواء، وهي ليلة ثلاث عشرة عند استواء القمر في النقلين.
